module Ballot where

import qualified DA.Map as M

import DA.Map as Map

count_yes : (Map.Map Party Bool) -> Int
count_yes votes =
  let (answers : [Bool]) = M.values votes in
  let count = 0 in
  let _damlforge_count2 =
        foldl
          (\count in_favor ->
            if in_favor
              then
                let _damlforge_count1 = count + 1 in
                _damlforge_count1
              else
                count)
          count answers
  in
  _damlforge_count2

template Ballot
  with
    organizer : Party
    voters : [Party]
    votes : Map.Map Party Bool
    owner : Party
  where
    signatory [organizer]
    observer voters

    choice CastVote : ContractId Ballot
      with
        voter : Party
        in_favor : Bool
      controller voter
      do
        let self = this
        assertMsg "voter is not on the voter list" (voter `elem` self.voters)
        assertMsg "voter has already voted" (M.lookup voter self.votes == None)
        let (new_votes : Map.Map Party Bool) = M.insert voter in_favor self.votes
        create (Ballot with organizer = self.organizer, voters = self.voters, votes = new_votes)

    choice Close : Bool
      controller organizer
      do
        let self = this
        pure ((count_yes self.votes * 2) > length self.voters)

  where

    ensure terms.amount > (1.5 : Decimal)

      controller arbiter
      do
